summary: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends that a Pedestrian Crossover (PXO) not be installed on Heather Road at the walkway opposite 33 Heather Road as the existing conditions do not meet the warrant for the installation of such a traffic control device. This location is currently uncontrolled.
decided: Scarborough Community Council: 1. Authorized installation of a Pedestrian Crossover on Heather Road at a point 175 metres west of Shilton Road. 2. Requested the Director, Transportation Services, Scarborough District to review speed sign placement and add new speed signs if required in front of the two schools in both directions and at both ends of the street.
